scenes.text: Have you ever wondered what absolute, pure silence actually sounds like, and why the quietest room on Earth is officially considered one of the most terrifying places for any human to visit?

Inside this ultra-isolated chamber, the silence is so incredibly deep that within minutes you will start loudly hearing your own heartbeat, your lungs expanding, and blood pumping directly to your brain.
Without any external sounds to orient your senses, your brain quickly enters a state of panic and starts to manufacture its own terrifying auditory hallucinations just to fill the empty space.
This eerie sensory deprivation literally begins to drive you completely mad in less than forty-five minutes, so tell us in the comments if you could actually survive this creepy challenge!
